subject: general
question: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
solution:
The correct option is __**NaCl**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical name of common salt is** Sodium Chloride**.
 
• Salt is a mineral composed primarily of sodium chloride (NaCl).
 
• Salt in the form of a natural crystalline mineral is known as **rock salt or halite**.
 
• Salt can be easily obtained from seawater. 
 
• The open ocean has about **35 g (1.2 oz)** of solids per litre of seawater, a salinity of 3.5%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NaOH**

 
 
• **Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH)** is also known as **lye** and** caustic soda**.
 
• Pure sodium hydroxide is a **colorless crystalline solid** with a** melting point **of **318 °C**.
 
• Some of its industrial uses are in the manufacturing of** pulp and paper**,** textiles**, **drinking water**, **soaps and detergents** etc.
 
 
 
• **KOH**
 
 
• **Potassium hydroxide (KOH)** is commonly called **caustic potash**.
 
• KOH is a prototypical **strong base**.
 
• It is a white solid that is **dangerously corrosive**.
 
 
 
• **HCL**
 
 
• **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)** is also known as **muriatic acid**.
 
• It is a colorless solution with a distinctive pungent smell.
 
• It is classified as a **strong acid**.
